import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_65/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_65/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_65/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_65/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_65/training_4.csv"
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# All source tables have the same schema and match the target schema exactly,
# so we perform a UNION (concatenation) of all source tables.
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the exact order and type as target schema:
# Target Schema: ['Year': string, 'Category': string, 'Nominee': string, 'Movie': string, 'Winner': string]
target_columns = ['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']
target_df = target_df[target_columns]

# Convert all columns to string type to match target schema exactly
for col in target_columns:
    target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(str)

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join all sources on 'Year' column stepwise, starting from source0 as base
df = source0.merge(source1, on='Year', suffixes=('', '_1'))
df = df.merge(source2, on='Year', suffixes=('', '_2'))
df = df.merge(source3, on='Year', suffixes=('', '_3'))
df = df.merge(source4, on='Year', suffixes=('', '_4'))

# After join, select columns from source0 only to match target schema exactly
# Because all sources have same schema, and target schema is same as source schema,
# but the target examples suggest no column duplication, so we keep only source0 columns.
df = df[['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']]

# Group by all columns to remove duplicates if any (target has no keys, but duplicates may exist)
df = df.groupby(['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner'], as_index=False).size()
df = df.drop(columns=['size'])  # size was just to force groupby, drop it

# Write output to target file
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
